newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes softer within range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes softer within range.

text.p: White sugar futures finished modestly lower on Tuesday after holding in a tight range in late trading.
May ended down $1.00 at $306.00, having moved in a range of just 70 cents all day. August was down 70 cents at $305.
Overall turnover was light at just 799 lots.
Light commission house selling countered trade buying of London's nearby white sugar futures to keep the market pinioned in tight trading ranges.
The New York market offered no suprises as prices there also remained locked in tight bands.
